journey.name: ST-06 No search matches is a different sentence from no tasks
journey.description:
Covers FR-10. REQUIREMENTS.md section 9 (lines 218-221) requires the two empties to read differently: "there is nothing here" and "nothing matches what you typed" are different facts.
The expected string uses typographic quotation marks, U+201C and U+201D, taken verbatim from task_list_no_matches. A straight-quote match is a failure, not a formatting detail.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Verify that "Renew domain registration" is on screen
Type "zzz" into the "Search by title" field
Verify that the text “No tasks match “zzz”.” is on screen, with typographic quotation marks around zzz
Verify that "No tasks yet. Tap + to add one." is not on screen
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is not on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Clear search"
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is on screen again
